figurative_meaning_bn: অতি ভীতসন্ত্রস্ত ব্যক্তি যে মুখ বুজে সব পীড়ন সহ্য করে
figurative_meaning_en: An extremely frightened person who silently endures all torments
similar_in_english: coward who takes it lying down
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গরু চোরের মতো কোনো প্রতিবাদ না করে চুপচাপ সব সহ্য করল।
যুদ্ধের সময় সে গরু চোরের ভঙ্গিতে লুকিয়ে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: He endured everything silently like a cow thief without any protest.
During the war, he hid in the posture of a scared cow thief.
history: In rural Bengal, cow theft was a serious crime, and thieves were often depicted as extremely cautious and fearful due to severe punishments, leading to this idiom symbolizing ultimate timidity.
note: The idiom draws from the cultural fear associated with cattle theft in agrarian Bengali society.
